label: Base: menú, submenús, tarjetas, imágenes y lectura
css: /* OIDFA · base: menú, submenús, tarjetas, imágenes y lectura *//* Menú principal: submenús como tarjeta */.elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-nav-menu--dropdown,.elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu{min-width:15.5rem!important;padding:.5rem 0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -14px rgba(18,35,61,.35);border:1px solid #F1E4D6;background:#fff;}.elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu a.elementor-sub-item{border-left:3px solid transparent;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}.elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu a.elementor-sub-item:hover,.elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu a.elementor-sub-item.elementor-item-active{border-left-color:var(--e-global-color-primary)}.elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-nav-menu .sub-arrow{padding-left:.35em}.elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-nav-menu .sub-arrow svg{width:.7em;height:.7em}/* Menú móvil */.elementor-nav-menu--dropdown.elementor-nav-menu__container{box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(18,35,61,.4);border-top:3px solid var(--e-global-color-primary);}.elementor-nav-menu--dropdown.elementor-nav-menu__container a{font-family:"Nunito Sans",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;border-bottom:1px solid #F3E9DE}.elementor-nav-menu--dropdown.elementor-nav-menu__container .sub-menu a{font-weight:600;font-size:16px;padding-left:2.6em!important;background:#FFFBF7}.elementor-menu-toggle{transition:background-color .2s}/* Tarjetas */.oidfa-card{transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,border-color .25s}.oidfa-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#F0C9AE!important;box-shadow:0 22px 40px -22px rgba(222,81,25,.45)!important}.oidfa-card .elementor-icon-box-title{margin-bottom:.4em}/* Imágenes con protagonismo (contenido, no cabecera ni pie) */.elementor-location-header img,.elementor-location-footer img{border-radius:0}main .elementor-widget-image:not(.elementor-widget-theme-site-logo) img,.site-main .elementor-widget-image img,.elementor-widget-image-carousel .swiper-slide-image,.elementor-widget-theme-post-featured-image img{border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -24px rgba(18,35,61,.45)}.elementor-widget-image-carousel .swiper-slide{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}/* Lectura */.elementor-widget-text-editor p{margin-bottom:1em}.elementor-widget-text-editor a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.elementor-widget-text-editor a:hover{color:var(--e-global-color-5ee71ba)}.elementor-widget-text-editor h3,.elementor-widget-text-editor h4{margin:1.2em 0 .5em}.elementor-widget-text-editor ul,.elementor-widget-text-editor ol{padding-left:1.3em;margin-bottom:1em}.elementor-widget-text-editor li{margin-bottom:.35em}::selection{background:#F9D9C4;color:#12233D}/* Botones: misma tipografía en toda la web */.elementor-button{font-family:"Nunito Sans",sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em}.elementor-button .elementor-button-icon svg{width:1em}@media (max-width:767px){.elementor-widget-text-editor{font-size:17px}}
